text.card: A red giant 1,352 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 0.81 solar masses and 14.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,459 K at its surface.
